column1: # Measured 2026-10-04 against /opt/homebrew/bin/zsh (zsh 5.9.2) with its own zargs:
# `zsh -fc 'autoload -Uz zargs; COMMAND; print -r -- st=$?'` in /tmp with
# PATH=/usr/bin:/bin, standard input /dev/null and both streams together;
zargs -- a b c -- echo X
zargs -n 2 -- a b c d e -- echo X
column2: X a~X b~X c~X d~X e~st=0~

column1: zargs -l 2 -- a b c d e -- echo
zargs -L 2 -- a b c d e -- echo
zargs -i -- a b c -- echo pre{}post

column2: zargs: value for max-args must be >= 1~st=1~

column1: zargs -n 2 -- a b c -- echo x y
zargs -n 3 -- a b c d e f g -- echo x
column2: x a b~x c d~x e f~x g~st=0~
